intro: First Watch is a daytime-only cafe serving fresh breakfast, brunch and lunch, known for made-to-order classics like the Farmhouse Hash and Chickichanga, healthier Power Bowls, the famous Avocado Toast and Million Dollar Bacon, plus juiced-in-house tonics. It opens in the morning and closes mid-afternoon. Below is the full First Watch menu with prices and calories for 2026.
quick_answer: First Watch is a daytime-only breakfast, brunch and lunch spot. Most breakfast classics and omelets run about $12 to $14, the famous Avocado Toast is $12.99, and Million Dollar Bacon is $5.99. Fresh juices like the Kale Tonic are around $5.29. There is no dinner; First Watch closes mid-afternoon.
hot_deal: First Watch doesn't run discount deals, but the value is in the fresh, made-to-order cooking. Crowd favorites are the Avocado Toast ($12.99), Million Dollar Bacon ($5.99) and the juiced-in-house Kale Tonic. Note it is daytime only, usually open until about 2:30 PM. Menu varies by season and location.

faqs.a: No. First Watch is daytime only, serving breakfast, brunch and lunch. Most locations open in the morning and close around 2:30 PM, so there is no dinner service.

faqs.q: What is Million Dollar Bacon at First Watch?
faqs.a: Million Dollar Bacon is First Watch's signature side: thick-cut bacon candied with brown sugar, black pepper, cayenne and maple. A side is about $5.99.
The Chickichanga is a breakfast chimichanga: a crispy flour tortilla stuffed with chicken, scrambled eggs and cheese, topped with chorizo gravy. It is about $13.49.

faqs.q: Does First Watch have healthy options?
faqs.a: Yes. First Watch is known for its healthier side, with Power Bowls, the Avocado Toast, the Tri-Athlete egg-white omelet, kale salads and juiced-in-house tonics like the Kale Tonic.

faqs.q: What are the most popular items at First Watch?
faqs.a: The best known are the Avocado Toast, the Chickichanga, the Farmhouse Hash, Million Dollar Bacon, and the Kale Tonic juice.
